newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Howard changes govt membership.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Howard changes govt membership.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard announced on Monday two changes to membership of his government.

Howard said Ian Campbell, a senator from the state of Western Australia, would vacate his position as parliamentary secretary to Environment Minister Robert Hill to become parliamentary secretary to Treasurer Peter Costello.
His appointment fills the vacancy left in mid-October when former parliamentary secretary to the Treasurer Brian Gibson was forced to resign because of a conflict of interest over shares he owned.
Howard said he had appointed Ian Macdonald, a senator from Queensland, as the new parliamentary secretary to the Environment Minister.
